How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Great question! Lead times vary by product type, production unit, and demand at the time, and the most accurate estimate is shown on the product page before you order (e.g. "Dispatched in 14–18 working days"). Your order confirmation email also lists the anticipated dispatch date for each item, and that date won't change 
.

Once dispatched, you'll get an email with the tracking link, and delivery is usually the next working day after dispatch. Lead times are in working days, so weekends aren't included.

If you'd like me to check exactly where your order is, just pop your order number and postcode over!
